19_3: Placement of the heat pump should take account of the following considerations:
19_4: Heat pump should not be exposed to direct radiation from a high-temperature heat source.
19_5: Heat pump should not be installed in positions where dust or dirt may affect heat exchangers.
19_6: Heat pump should not be installed in locations where exposure to oil or to corrosive or harmful gases, such as acidic or alkaline gases, may occur.
19_7: Heat pump should not be installed in locations where exposure to salinity may occur.
19_8: Heat pump should be installed in well-drained, well-ventilated positions.
19_9: Heat pump should be installed in positions that are as close as possible to the heat emitters.
19_10: Heat pump should be installed in positions that are sufficiently close to the desired position of the wired controller that the controller’s wiring length limitation will not be exceeded.
19_11: In systems that are configured to heat domestic hot water and/or include an external backup electric heater, Heat pump should be installed in positions that are sufficiently close to the domestic hot water tank and/or backup electric heater that the temperature sensor wiring length limitations will not be exceeded.
19_12: Heat pump should be installed in locations where the noise from the unit will not disturb neighbors.
